italian-reading-7.title: GN
italian-reading-7.subtitle: Hear GN as one sound
italian-reading-7.description: Recognize GN as one consonant combination and read familiar words.

ir7-p1.translations: The gentleman prepares lasagna. Then he takes a bath.

ir7-t1.text: gn represents one consonant combination: listen to bagno, lasagna, signore.

ir7-t2.text: Keep GN together when dividing these words into syllables: ba-gno, la-sa-gna, si-gno-re.

ir7_q1.question: How is GN read in the words from this lesson?

options.ir7_q1_opt2: As two fully separate consonant sounds
options.ir7_q1_opt3: As a G sound with no N

ir7_q2.question: How is "bagno" correctly divided into syllables?

ir7_q4.question: Which syllable division keeps GN together?
